targeting.title: n8n Wait Node: Resume URL, Webhook Waits and Stuck Executions
targeting.metaTitle: n8n Wait Node: Resume URL, Timers, Stuck Fixes
targeting.metaDescription: n8n Wait node explained: timed waits and the 65 second rule, $execution.resumeUrl, Limit Wait Time, 401, 404 and 409 answers, and executions stuck in Waiting.
targeting.excerpt: A source-verified guide to the n8n Wait node: what waiting means inside n8n, the 65 second rule, how $execution.resumeUrl is built and validated, what the node outputs after a webhook or a timeout, every answer of the resume endpoint, delays per item, and the causes of executions stuck in Waiting.
targeting.keywords: n8n wait node, n8n wait node webhook, n8n wait node stuck, n8n wait for webhook, n8n resume url, n8n execution resumeUrl, n8n wait until, n8n delay between items, n8n wait for approval, n8n pause workflow, n8n webhook waiting
targeting.summary: Timers under 65 seconds sleep in the process; longer timers and every webhook or form wait are saved with the status Waiting and resumed by a service on the main process that polls every 60 seconds|$execution.resumeUrl holds the execution ID and a signature token, must be sent before the Wait node, uses GET by default, and after a webhook resume the node outputs the request instead of its input items|Stuck executions come from a callback that never ended the wait (409 too early, 404 wrong method or suffix, 401 missing token, unreachable URL), no Limit Wait Time, a stopped main process or a workflow timeout shorter than the wait
targeting.author: Ali Rehman

overlap.note: No existing post covers the Wait node. The Loop Over Items guide mentions a Wait node for rate limits and the sub-workflow guide covers waiting for a child workflow; both are linked instead of repeated.

research.selection: Thirty candidate seeds across the n8n cluster were checked first (docs/content-research/2026-11-11-keywords-n8n.json). Schedule Trigger and error handling had the richest suggestions, but DuckDuckGo samples for both showed many dedicated blog guides. 'n8n wait node' returned 10 suggestions (webhook, stuck, bug, example, wait for node to finish, merge node wait for all inputs, wait for all nodes to finish, wait for multiple nodes, wait for two nodes) and the sample for 'n8n wait node stuck' was dominated by community threads, GitHub issues and the documentation, with no dedicated source level guide. Thirty focused seeds followed: 'n8n wait until' (10: wait for webhook, wait for approval, wait for user input, wait for response, wait for sub workflow completion), 'n8n human in the loop' (10), 'n8n delay' (7: delay node, delay between items, random delay, http request delay), 'n8n pause workflow' (6), 'n8n waiting execution' (6, including 'n8n querying database for waiting executions'), 'n8n wait for webhook' (5), 'n8n resume url' (3) and 'n8n webhook-waiting' (3).

competitorAndCaseReview.finding: Documents the four resume options, the parameters, Limit Wait Time, Webhook Suffix, the partial execution limitation and the note that waits under 65 seconds are not offloaded. Does not cover the tracker's poll, the signature token, endpoint responses, the output after a webhook resume versus a timeout, the early callback conflict or the timeout on resume.

competitorAndCaseReview.source: n8n source Wait.node.ts, validation.ts and base-execute-context.ts at the 2.47.4 tag
competitorAndCaseReview.finding: Versions 1 and 1.1 and their defaults, wake up calculation, validation messages, acceptsResumeRequest false for timers, MAX_IN_PROCESS_WAIT_MS 65000, WAIT_INDEFINITELY 3000-01-01, WAIT_FOR_SUB_EXECUTION 2999-12-31, input items returned unchanged.

competitorAndCaseReview.source: n8n source wait-tracker.ts, execution.repository.ts, resume-attempt.service.ts, executions.config.ts
competitorAndCaseReview.finding: 60 second poll on the leader, 70 second selection window, immediate first poll, 'Only saved workflows can be resumed.', stored workflow data used on resume, N8N_EXECUTIONS_MAX_RESUME_ATTEMPTS default 2 then crashed, parent parked on a sub-execution and swept each tick.

competitorAndCaseReview.source: n8n source waiting-webhooks.ts, get-additional-keys.ts, webhook-helpers.ts, endpoints.config.ts, Webhook description.ts
competitorAndCaseReview.finding: resumeUrl = waiting base + execution ID + signature token; 401 Invalid token, 404 not found or no matching path/method, 409 running already, finished already or finished with error, 307 redirect for form waits; token stripped from the request; request item placed on the resuming node; endpoints webhook-waiting and form-waiting with their environment variables; HTTP Method default GET, Respond default Immediately.

On resume the workflow timeout is reduced by the time since the original start and the execution is stopped at once when nothing is left; EXECUTIONS_TIMEOUT default -1, EXECUTIONS_TIMEOUT_MAX default 3600 seconds.
